changelog: Fixed Live Map view dropdown so Main, Active Now, and Suspicious are visible and selectable again
Setup sheet version now stays synchronized with the installed Workspace Watchdog version after updates and reloads
Fresh and fast installs now initialize the updater version property so version checks and the Setup sheet agree
Standardized the internal monitor version and release metadata on 3.7.2
Hardened license enforcement across scheduled sync, manual sync, backfill, reports, Live Map data endpoints, raw data API access, and maintenance functions
Expired trial licenses now shut down immediately instead of continuing through a trial grace period
Unlicensed installations are now blocked from running Workspace Watchdog monitoring functions
Paid licenses retain the existing 30-day grace period after expiration
Improved expired-license revalidation caching so expired installations do not repeatedly contact the license server on every open or sync
